text:
maia: quick announcement — next deploy window (Mon 06:00 UTC) will use a 20% initial canary for routes that pass the stable-fallback and autoscale checks. aim: faster detection of perf regressions.

toni: please ensure autoscale_required is enforced. last time a small canary caused connection storms.

maia: yes — autoscale required + automatic rollback when error_rate > 0.5% for 5m. fallback model must be configured.

raj: what about critical customer-facing routes?

maia: routes labeled "critical-sla" are excluded by default. owners can set dedicated_fallback: true for extra isolation.

sasha: ops note: temporary quiet window shift to reduce midweek churn — Sat 18:00 -> Mon 06:00 UTC for the next two cycles. emergency rollouts still permitted with ENG-LEAD + SRE approval via #release-exceptions.

deploy-bot: :loud_sound: Scheduled rollout: canary-defaults/v2024.11 -> Mon 06:00 UTC; owners: maia, toni. link: https://console.redwood.example/releases/2024.11

maia: docs snippet (will be posted tonight):

rollout:
  initial_canary: 0.2
  autoscale_required: true
  monitor:
    error_rate_threshold: 0.005
    evaluation_window_seconds: 300
  fallback_model: compatible-1.3
  exclude_labels: ["critical-sla"]

raj: i'll run a quick perf sweep on dedicated pools pre-rollout. DM me if you want to hold.

maia: thanks — DM by EOD if you need exclusion. :thumbsup:
